_what: The app's visual system. The Ledger, Trail and doors were specified as behaviour; this is how they look.

type.display: Iowan Old Style / Palatino / Georgia serif

PLAYER.frame: full-bleed 9:16; on desktop centred with 20px radius and a deep shadow
PLAYER.chrome: progress ticks at the top, one per beat; language pills top-right; nothing else
PLAYER.rule: No scrubber, no play button overlay, no timestamp. Tap to pause.
PLAYER.autoplay: the next film begins on the landing, continuous where the join is continuous

DOORS.appearance: appear only after the landing, as a row of pills across the bottom over a gradient
DOORS.secondary: follow a character · ask the source · the trail — outlined
DOORS.return: a detour returns to the exact frame and timecode; a thin gold line at the top shows the held position

blocks_in_order: names you have heard but not met
what a character knows right now
what the text does not say
LEDGER.type: serif for content, sans for labels; quiet, book-like
LEDGER.the_line: He does not know who Rāvaṇa is. Nobody has told him. — computed, not written

TRAIL.what: the films as a path, watched ones lit
TRAIL.debts: drawn as long curves across the path; a paid promise visibly CLOSES its arc
TRAIL.map_view: the same story on a map of India — Ayodhyā, Mithilā, Chitrakūṭ, Kiṣkindhā, Rāmeśvaram
TRAIL.reward: the closing arc is the reward. No badge, ever.

ONBOARDING.rule: Watch first. The email comes after the second film, never before.
ONBOARDING.copy: Four more are coming. No account, no card, no newsletter.
never: a permissions prompt before any content

NEVER: streaks or shame for a missed day
engagement-ordered feeds — if the algorithm reorders the Rāmāyaṇa it stops being the Rāmāyaṇa
a comments section under the Rāmāyaṇa
